name: loot
description: Every AI session drops loot. /loot finds what's worth keeping, rates it by rarity, and ships it as a repo, skill, blog post or demo.

interface.shortDescription: Ship the valuable parts of your sessions
interface.longDescription: Scans the session for anything worth keeping, rates each drop by rarity, and turns the good ones into a repo, skill, blog post or demo after you approve.
defaultPrompt: What from this session is worth shipping?
Turn this into a repo and a blog post.
